# Geyser Developers

> The main branch describes the 0.2.0 source preview. Published 0.1.0 and running services are separate release states.

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): Execute a real sandboxed JSON handler.
- [Authentication](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open/blob/main/docs/authentication.md): Project setup and exact issued API URL.
- [SDK](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open/blob/main/docs/sdk.md): Owned inputs, bounded tasks and typed results.
- [Extensions](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open/blob/main/docs/extensions.md): Exact publisher trust and actual installation.
- [Availability](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): Runtime requirements and preview boundaries.
- [Costs and limits](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open/blob/main/docs/program.md): Account billing, constraints and support.
